notes.title: Go Morse Go! Arcade Edition: Homecoming Update
notes.content:
Get hyped! Go Morse Go! Arcade Edition: Homecoming Update is now live! This free content update adds 26 new costumes - some of them are home uniform versions of existing outfits, and some are brand new characters, including a certain crustacean who's made cameo appearances in my other games, a member of the marching band, and a couple of my 20 year-old cats who left my world earlier this year. I miss you every day, Max and Maxx.

But enough bummers; you're probably wondering how to access these outfits. It's simple! On the outfit select screen, enter the letter of the outfit that you're already wearing, and it'll swap you to the alternate outfit menu. To swap immediately, remember, the default is usually outfit E, but in Training Mode, it's outfit T.

...oh yeah, there's also a Training Mode! With no time limit, you can play at your own pace, and practice your Morse code without the usual 5-second rush my games tend to have. You can even filter which letters you practice - select all letters, just the easy ones (1-3 dots/dashes), just the hard ones (4 dots/dashes), or choose A to Z to do a 26-round drill where you enter all the letters in order.

By the way, the new outfits are unlocked alongside their "away team" counterparts, so regardless of how many outfits you've unlocked, this update instantly doubles it. Enjoy!

Go Morse Go! Arcade Edition version 1.1.0 changelog:

-It's the Homecoming Update!
-Added 26 new outfits
-Added training mode
-HLC

notes.title: GMG!AE version 1.0.3 is live!
notes.content:
As you may have noticed, there are seven outfits unlocked from the beginning - six normal-looking cheerleader outfits and one robotic cyclops bunny (the Mundroid, a character from my previous game Fist's Elimination Tower). The Mundroid unlock was supposed to be triggered by having a Fist's Elimination Tower game save on your computer, but that didn't work as well as I planned, and it wound up unlocking the character on every copy of the game, which is troubling, especially since it's usually the final "outfit" you unlock.

This patch removes this unlock, but if you want to use it, go to the options menu, and using any of the telegraphs, enter "FIST" in Morse code (..-. .. ... -). You'll hear a chime after each letter is entered, and receive a confirmation from Samantha when done. I'll just leave it on the honor system and assume that if you enter it, you own Fist's Elimination Tower, and if not... well, it's a really fun game, you should check it out!

Update 1.0.3 details:


    Removed instant Mundroid unlock
    Added Mundroid unlock code
    Selecting "no music" on options screen now also turns off music on the title screen
    In Pro and Remorseless difficulties, the Morse guide now appears during the dress-up phase
    Added detail to Pep Rally mode's hype meter

notes.title: GMG!AE version 1.0.2 is live!
notes.content:
Good evening! I hope you're all enjoying Go Morse Go! Arcade Edition so far, but for those of you who beat Tournament mode and don't like being immobile horses for all of time afterwards, you might really enjoy this patch.

Update 1.0.2 details:


    Changed Esc key's functionality on title screen. It now sends the player to the options menu instead of immediately exiting the game.
    Pressing one of the options menu keys/buttons on the title screen during the "waiting for more players" phase now resets the title screen.
    Fixed the Trophy Horse bug.


And remember, LOOK OUT FOR FIS... oh wait, wrong game, sorry.
